program.description: The executable name or absolute path of the program to launch.

arguments.description: List of command-line arguments to pass to the program.

start_date_format.description: Strftime format string for displaying the start date.

log_file.description: Path to the file where standard output is logged.

error_log_file.description: Path to the file where standard error is logged.

enable_logging.description: Whether to enable logging of output and errors.

shutdown_method.description: Shutdown method to use: gnome, kde, hal, consolekit, or sudo.

gnome_power_cmd.description: Path to the gnome-power-cmd script used by the gnome shutdown method.

sudo_user.description: User or group pattern allowed to use sudo for shutdown if method is sudo.
